notes.text: Blitz Split now speaks Dutch, Japanese, Turkish and Indonesian, and the language list names each language in its own language.
Groups and bills can now use the Polish zloty, the Turkish lira and the Indonesian rupiah.
Profile has a new button, Share profile: whoever opens your link sees your name and photo and can invite you to a group.
A new group's invite link is ready right away, even offline, and Members has a new button to copy it.
Closing a form with something you haven't saved now asks "Discard changes?" first.
The Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service now open inside the app instead of the browser.
On a phone, the top and bottom bars now get out of the way when you scroll down and come back when you scroll up.
On Split a bill, picking a date no longer jumps straight to the clock: the time has its own button.
Tap the group at the top of Split a bill to open it; going back returns to the bill with everything you typed.
Home's Latest expenses now show each bill's group and who paid as photos.
Pix now shows only to people likely to use it, such as those using the app in Portuguese, with a Pix key or in a group in reais.
"Syncing…" now shows only the first time your account loads on a device, not on every sync.
Profile no longer offers to disconnect Google or Apple from your account: sign out or delete the account instead.
Edit profile now opens as a sheet over Profile instead of a separate screen.
The blank band between the form and the keyboard on Split a bill is gone.
A contact's Groups in common now show each group's photo.
